items.title: Supply chain attack on arrayref
items.blurb: What happened On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the proc-macro1 crate was malicious. The Rust Security Response Team verified this to be the case: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload.

items.title: Why compiling Rust to WebAssembly is slow
items.blurb: Compiling Rust to WebAssembly with debug info is slower than it should be. Sometimes unbearably slower.

items.title: What Zig felt like, coming from Rust
items.blurb: What Zig felt like, coming from Rust Intro I’ve spent the last 7 years as a Rust developer, working mostly on open source projects, and I’d like to think I’ve built a solid feel for the language and its ecosystem along the way.
